name: FormPromo
title: promo films from your own media, style and sourced claims
summary: FormPromo turns a kit of your media, style and sourced claims and one of 76 templates into a promo film, a FormCut or FormVFX project or a FormEncoder delivery.
lede: FormPromo is the Form family's promo app. Gather a kit of your images, video, music, style and sourced claims, pick one of 76 templates and preview the promo, then end with a rendered film, a real FormCut or FormVFX project or a FormEncoder delivery. It works in a desktop window, from the command line, from an agent over MCP or from a panel inside FormVFX.
checks: Builds a promo from a kit of your images, video, audio, logos, style, product information and sourced claims, and one of 76 built-in templates.
Renders a finished MP4 with its music bed, has FormCut or FormVFX write a real .fc or .fvxproj project, or has FormEncoder encode and verify a delivery.
Treats every fact about the product as a claim with a source: a claim marked check builds with a warning, and one marked cut is never built.
Serves 35 MCP tools to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; by default a tool that changes anything asks once per agent per session in the FormPromo window.

facts.dd: Python and FastAPI, on 127.0.0.1:8350 by default and answering only this computer
Vanilla TypeScript and Vite, in a Tauri 2 shell that runs the engine as a sidecar
76 built-in; your own are shared as .fptemplate files
Rendered with ffmpeg and the Chromium that Playwright brings

chapters.title: A kit of your own media and sourced claims
chapters.text: A kit holds the product's information, claims with sources, copy, features, style, assets, music beds and targets. A claim marked check builds with a warning shown in FormPromo, a claim marked cut is never built, and an export writes the credits of the assets it uses beside the file.

chapters.title: 76 templates, watched in every size they make
chapters.text: The 76 built-in templates run from a 139 s launch film in four acts to a 4 s logo sting, in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1 and the App Store's preview sizes. Click one in the gallery to watch it in every size it makes, side by side, from your kit or the sample kit.

chapters.title: A film, a project or a delivery
chapters.text: export film renders the finished MP4 with the bed, motion blur and synthesised sound design. export formcut and export formvfx have FormCut and FormVFX write a real .fc or .fvxproj project, and encode has FormCut write a project per aspect and FormEncoder render, encode and verify it.

features.title: Kits
features.text: A kit says what a product is and what may be said about it: info, claims with sources, copy, features, style, assets, music beds and targets.
bullets: kit new, kit add with a licence and a role, and kit check on the command line
A claim marked check builds with a warning; a claim marked cut is never built
kit check notes a credit the kit lacks, an unconfirmed music licence and restricted assets
A chart scene draws numeric claims, each marked measured, target or sample

features.title: Templates
features.text: 76 built-in templates, each whole in its template.json and catalogued in templates/README.md.
bullets: From a 139 s launch film in four acts to a 4 s logo sting
16:9, 9:16 and 1:1, plus 886:1920 and 3:4 for App Store previews
A template names no product, so the same template builds any kit
Duplicate one and share it as a .fptemplate file, the same bytes every time

features.title: Preview
features.text: A promo is previewed in the window on FormPromo's own timeline.
bullets: Click a template in the gallery to watch it in every size it makes, side by side
Each cut selectable, from your kit or the sample kit
render writes chosen frames, for example --frames 0,120,600
Contact sheets by beat, strip, overview, phone or named frames

features.title: Finished film
features.text: export film renders the finished MP4 itself, with the bed, and needs only ffmpeg and the Chromium that Playwright brings.
bullets: The camera punches in on each click and the type rises word by word
Feature beats alternate between a type card and a split
Frames carry motion blur, and synthesised sound design sits under the bed
Clicks, typing ticks and whooshes sit on a second audio track that plays only when chosen
Loop exports as GIF and WebM

features.title: FormCut, FormVFX and FormEncoder
features.text: The same build can open as a project in another FormAI app or go out as a delivery that FormEncoder has verified.
bullets: export formcut has FormCut write a real .fc: the kit's media, one track per layer, the bed under it
Each take carries the film's camera moves and each line its rise as keyframes
export formvfx has FormVFX write a .fvxproj with the text slots as Template Controls
encode has FormCut write a project per aspect and FormEncoder render, encode and verify it
./formpromo outputs lists which outputs are ready on this computer

features.title: Music
features.text: A template's steps take bars of the kit's music bed and may pin to its markers, so cuts stay on bar lines.
bullets: music cut makes a bed of a track for every cut of a template
Beds cut to any length keep the music at full level until the end card and end on the track's own close
music ending lands the track's own close on the cut's last hit
A beat grid for any track; a kit with no bed for a cut builds on a silent bed

features.title: Motion and text
features.text: Motion profiles (calm, crisp, lively) set the eases, holds and overshoot of every scene from one kit field.
bullets: A highlight sweep behind a word and a cycling word in a fixed line
Word-synced captions from an SRT or VTT transcript, also written as .srt and .vtt beside the export
Safe-zone presets for feed, stories, YouTube and App Store frames, shaded on stills with --safe-overlay
Placeholder copy is labelled Example text on screen until it is replaced

features.title: Checks
features.text: formpromo lint and check-film, also available as the MCP tools lint and check_film.
bullets: Pops, jumps, frozen or blank stretches, a bad loop seam or ending
A weak mix or mono fold and a loud muted layer
Export settings a channel rejects
Every command says what is wrong in words and exits 1 when it cannot do the job

features.title: The window
features.text: Kits, Style, Info and claims, Templates, Template editor, Preview, Outputs and Agents on one rail, with a terminal dock.
bullets: Opens on the Templates page; Settings has the switch to turn that off
Terminal tabs run a shell, Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, always in the agent folder
The Outputs page lists the running FormEncoder's presets
From source, ./formpromo opens the installed app, else a Chromium-family browser in app mode, else the default browser

features.title: Command line
features.text: ./formpromo is the command line over the same engine, formpromo.bat on Windows.
bullets: kit, template, build, music, export, encode, render and outputs
doctor says what is installed and whether the engine answers
build writes the promo document beside the kit
Every root the scripts read comes from formpromo.config.json, overridden by FORMPROMO_<ROOT> or FORMPROMO_WORKSPACE

features.title: Agents and MCP
features.text: 35 tools on the formpromo MCP server, over stdio with ./formpromo mcp and over HTTP at the engine's /mcp.
bullets: agents install adds the server and the harness skill to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
Read-only tools never ask; a changing tool asks once per agent per session in the window
Replacing a template asks every time; the policy is ask (the default), allowed or blocked
./formpromo claude opens Claude Code in the agent folder with this server and the harness skill

features.title: FormVFX panel
features.text: A panel for FormVFX's extension host: pick a kit and a template inside FormVFX and the promo is laid into the open project as one undo step.
bullets: Builds a new composition or places the promo into the one that is open
Builds pass the same consent gate as an outside agent
Installed as a .formpkg from FormVFX's extensions panel or FormPortal
The panel cannot start the engine: open FormPromo first

features.title: Desktop app
features.text: A Tauri shell starts the frozen engine as a sidecar on a free port, hands it a fresh launch token, opens the window and stops the engine on exit.
bullets: Built by formcompiler on macOS, Linux and Windows
Ships the engine, the 76 built-in templates, the sample kit and the agent skills
macOS 12.0 or newer
Registered for .fptemplate template files

features.title: The FormVis films
features.text: The repo keeps the pipeline that made the FormVis promo films (2:19, 67 s, 26 s, music-synced, 1080p and 4K), the method the templates grew from.
bullets: Every shot is the real app, recorded frame by frame in headless Chromium
The edit is a deterministic HTML timeline rendered frame by frame
Playwright capture drivers, track analysis, beds and per-version EDLs
The launch films are kept as a kit in examples/formvis-launch

requirements: ffmpeg and the Chromium that Playwright brings, for films
Rust and, on Linux, WebKitGTK 4.1, for the desktop app
docs.agents: ./formpromo agents install adds the MCP server and the harness skill to Claude Code, Codex and Cursor; the server runs on stdio with ./formpromo mcp and over HTTP at the engine's /mcp.

topics.title: Kits and templates
topics.text: contracts/README.md says what a kit, a template and a promo document may hold, with the bindings, timing, scene types and layouts per aspect.

topics.title: Template catalogue
topics.text: templates/README.md lists all 76 built-in templates with their cuts, aspects and what each needs from a kit.

topics.title: Command line
topics.text: The README's Command line section shows every command, from kit new to export formcut, encode and render.

topics.title: Agents and consent
topics.text: The README's Agents section covers agents install, the consent policy and the terminals; the harness skill's references/tools.md lists the 35 tools.

topics.title: Paths
topics.text: The README's Paths section lists every root the scripts read from formpromo.config.json and how to override each one.

topics.title: Licences
topics.text: LICENSES.md lists every dependency, program and data file FormPromo uses, and whether it ships in a build.

items: The Windows desktop app no longer opens to a blank window when an installer set the .js file type to text/plain
Film and Loop export no longer need ffmpeg or Chromium installed: the desktop app downloads them when needed
On Linux the packages pull in GStreamer's plugins, so the film preview plays on a fresh install
On Windows a failed install step now fails formpromo install and formpromo install-desktop instead of being reported as success
On macOS every binary in the engine folder inside the app is signed so the app can be notarized
Line endings are fixed in the repository: LF for everything, CRLF for Windows scripts
The sample kit is replaced when this build ships a newer revision, and the old copy is moved aside, never deleted
The template editor has real controls: pick a scene type to add and set how it looks and moves
Scene settings are one catalogue, served at GET /api/scene-params and as the MCP tool scene_params
Every page fits the window without a page scroll
